import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
def model(p,t,P):
    w=p[0]
    return p[1]+p[2]*P+p[3]*P**2+(p[4]+p[5]*P+p[6]*P**2)*np.sin(w*t)+(p[7]+p[8]*P+p[9]*P**2)*np.cos(w*t)
def res(p): return model(p,t,P)-dP_dt
p0=np.array([0.356,0,1,0,0,0,0,0,0,0.])
sol=least_squares(res,p0)
print(np.round(sol.x,4), np.sum(sol.fun**2)/np.sum((dP_dt-dP_dt.mean())**2))
